how_to_run: Build a catalog of every installed skill's name + description (this kit's skills plus the externals/companions a workspace normally has), mix all eval queries into one numbered list, and have 3 independent judges route each query using ONLY the catalog — no repo access. Majority vote per query. Pass = trigger queries route here; no-trigger queries route anywhere else ('route' names the expected sibling, diagnostic only). In this repo, tools/trigger-evals/ holds the checked-in harness.

queries.q: Add a new skill to the agent-skills-kit repo
Rewrite this SKILL.md to match the kit's house style
What's the word budget for a kit SKILL.md?
Tighten the description of the polish-batch skill
Where do the canonical one-liners for the kit live?
Draft the SKILL.md for a new dep-upgrade kit skill
Move this skill's long examples out of SKILL.md properly
Write release notes for last week
Write a skill for my other project's deploy flow
Document our coding style in CONTRIBUTING
Refactor this module to be more readable
Run the trigger evals for the kit
